description: Safe Drinking Water Programs is a dataset listed in State of Oregon open data portal (data.oregon.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Oregon. Loans and grants from the Safe Drinking Water loan programs made in Fiscal Years 2019-2026 under ORS 285A.213. Safe Drinking Water loan programs fund drinking water system improvements needed to maintain compliance with the Federal Safe Drinking Water Act. For more information visit. Coverage: Oregon. The portal files it under the category Revenue & Expense. Its tags are water, drinking water source protection fund, fiscal year 2019, fiscal year 2020, fiscal year 2021. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: Business Oregon. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oregon-gov-portal.
